header: Several voices in one band, one at a time
lead: The track is a scroll-snap row, so it works before any script runs: drag it, flick it, or tab into it and use the arrow keys. The two buttons are the affordance a mouse has no other way to reach, and they grey out at either end rather than lying about what they will do.

quotes.quote_text: Each card is a figure: a blockquote for the words, a figcaption for the person, and a portrait when there is one.
quotes.author: The first card
quotes.role: Every card is the same shape

quotes.quote_text: Two to twelve quotes. Below 768px the arrows are removed, because a touch screen already has the better control.
quotes.author: The second card
quotes.role: Cards stay level whatever their length

quotes.quote_text: This is the only element in the content group with a script hook, and the hook adds nothing the browser already does.
quotes.author: The third card
quotes.role: Behaviour lives in the shared runtime
